name: toketer
description: A live fuel gauge for AI coding: see how many tokens each AI prompt used and what it cost, right inside your editor. Metadata-only, private, zero-config.

chatParticipants.name: toketer
chatParticipants.description: Chat and see the real token cost of every prompt

toketer.currency.markdownDescription: Currency used to display AI costs. `auto` picks ₹ (INR) or $ (USD) from your editor locale.

toketer.usdToInrRate.markdownDescription: Exchange rate used to convert internal USD cost estimates into INR for display.

toketer.pricing.apiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL used by **Toketer: Refresh Pricing Table** to fetch an updated model pricing table. Toketer works fully offline with its bundled prices; this is only used when you run that command.

toketer.sources.claudeCode.enabled.markdownDescription: Automatically read **Claude Code** local session logs to capture exact token usage (metadata only — never prompt or file contents). If no logs are found, Toketer stays silent.

toketer.sources.claudeCode.logPath.markdownDescription: Optional override for the Claude Code `projects` logs folder, for non-standard installs. Leave empty to auto-detect (`~/.claude/projects`, `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects`, …).

toketer.sources.copilotEstimate.enabled.markdownDescription: Show a **live, clearly-labelled estimate** of GitHub Copilot cost (on by default). No public API exposes Copilot's tokens, so Toketer detects each agent *turn* from the edits it makes (reading only the *size* of each change, never the content) and counts it as one premium request. Always shown as an estimate (`~`). For exact figures use **Toketer: Import Copilot Usage**.

toketer.sources.copilotEstimate.pricePer.markdownDescription: US-dollar price per GitHub Copilot premium request, used by the live estimate. Adjust to match your plan's overage rate.
